model: GWNP Series wall gas sensor platform (AG sensors)
applies_to: Veris GWNP wall-mounted gas platforms fitted with a Veris AG Series gas sensor, on BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The GWNP is a wall platform that carries one replaceable Veris AG gas sensor (single or dual gas) and reports it over BACnet MS/TP or Modbus. It exposes the gas readings, sensor life and runtime, writable high/low alarm setpoints and hysteresis, two setpoint-exceeded BIs and BVs to override the two relays.
notes: Which gases are measured depends on the AG sensor fitted; Sensor2 reads Reliability = No Sensor on single-gas sensors.
With an NO2 sensor the Present_Value is 10x the actual ppm (12 = 1.2 ppm).
Names with * are preserved through power outages.
Units of AI 1/AI 2 and the setpoint AVs follow the sensor (normally ppm).
Source: GWNP Series Installation Guide Z207135-0F.

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address and BACnet mode on the DIP switches, then read the gas concentration(s) and the two setpoint-exceeded BIs; watch Lifetime for sensor replacement. Setpoints can be set over BACnet once BV 6 Lock_Settings hands control to the registers.
setup: BACnet MS/TP: ADDRESS DIP positions 1-7 set the MAC (0-127), position 8 selects BACnet or Modbus; CONFIG DIP sets baud (9600-76800) and autobaud.
Device instance = 133 (Identifier_Value_Prefix, AV 2) followed by the MS/TP address; also writable via AV 1.
gotchas: NO2 readings are 10x the real value; scale by 0.1.
DIP switches override written settings unless BV 6 Lock_Settings is active.
Relay override BVs (2-5) take the relays away from the gas alarms; leave them inactive in normal use.
